_comment: The shared RuleToken vocabulary (#634). Read by core/src/vault/manifest/token/tests/vocabulary.rs and by conformance_lib/sections/rule_token_vocabulary.py, so the Rust enum and the Python exception attributes cannot drift onto different spellings. `phase_dependent` marks docs/vault-format.md §4.2's re-encode-visible faults (§6.2 rules 1-3, trailing bytes, the array sort disciplines). §4.2's freedom is a property of a PAIR: since #646 the replay harness tolerates a pair only when one member is flagged here and both are manifest rules other than rule 4 and malformed_cbor, which is 30 of the 153 unequal pairs. Python reads this column only to compare it against its own hard-coded reading of §4.2; no Python behaviour depends on it.
